tools.name: get_listing_info
tools.description:
How an AI product gets listed on Hokai: today's one-time price, what a
    listing includes, and the free badge route. Use this before submit_listing,
    or to answer "how do I get my AI tool listed on Hokai?".

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description:
Start a Hokai directory listing for an AI tool, model, agent, MCP server,
    skill or AI service. Returns a payment link: a PERSON must open it and pay
    the one-time fee. Nothing is charged by this call, and the submission is
    reviewed by a human (full refund if the product is not a fit). Pay

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "submit_listing" is 713 chars, far longer than this server's median (135). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_listing · Public sink: submit_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
